body:
Good news on this! I've determined this regression happened with PR #88628.

It looks like there, mix rate methods may have been implemented for some parts of the audio system, but not all (possibly excluding AudioEffectCapture or AudioStreamGenerator)? I'll try to look a bit more into it soon.

Even better news! I think I understand why the problem occurs, and how to fix it.

After PR #88628, the output audio sampling rate is determined by CoreAudio. I can see when running Godot in verbose mode that, for me, it's 48,000 Hz. However, by default, the AudioStreamGenerator uses a mix rate of 44,100 Hz.

So, based on my understanding of audio, what I *think* is happening is that the Capture effect is outputting samples meant for a 48,000 Hz mix rate, but the Generator processes them at a 44,100 Hz mix rate. Since that's lower than what the Capture effect is outputting, the resulting audio sounds slowed and pitched down.

If I set the Generator's mix rate to 48,000 Hz, then the music sounds normal:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1aac6f3f-99e8-4e95-aa2e-4bedf347fbbf

I'm not sure how exactly this would be "fixed", since it seems to be technically working correctly - it's just unclear to the user what is causing the problem. Perhaps the AudioStreamGenerator could have a boolean property that sets the mix rate to whatever the system mix rate is, rather than having the user manually set its value?


At the least, given that the PR says this:

> Instead of "mix_rate" from the project settings, use preferred OS values, since API can work only with the limited set of values depending on device.

We should probably add some kind of warning or notice to the "Mix Rate" project setting that it won't apply on iOS and macOS. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3c574a4a-1279-4dec-826e-1050942fc36d)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e6c1dc50-84ef-4ff4-9dd5-75df8ef22698)

This looks like an issue with your script that is reading raw frames from one stream and writing it to another without resampling (or setting mix rates to match). But documentation probably should be updated to note how default `max_rate` is used. And maybe `AudioStreamGenerator` should have presets to automatically match either input or output rate of the `AudioServer` if it's used with a captured stream.
